title: Heart Of Hussain a.s
body:
Heart Of Hussain a.s
<<MINI>>
Imam Hussain a.s 5x
Imam Hussain a.s 4x
<<DIVIDER>>
Asalamo Alaika Ya Aba Abdillah a.s
Asalamo Alaika Yabna Rasoolillah s.a.w.w
<<MINI>>
Imam Hussain a.s 4x
Imam Hussain a.s 4x
<<DIVIDER>>
He Is The Son Of Ali a.s And Fatima s.a
He Is The Grand Son Of Muhammad Rasool Allah s.a.w.w
He Is The Carrier Of The Purest Heart
In His Blessed Household He's Shining Like A Star
He Has The Highest Status One Can Gain
<<MINI>>
Allah Look At The Heart Of Imam Hussain a.s 3x
<<DIVIDER>>
He Spent His Life Helping The Needy
He Fed The Orphans Whilst Everyone Would Sleep
He Gave Every Thing Generously
He Wiped All The Tears of Anyone Who Would Weep
He Is The Definition Of Human
<<MINI>>
Allah Look At The Heart Of Imam Hussain a.s 3x
<<DIVIDER>>
He Was The Merciful And Filled With Love
The Angels Would Arrive At His Door From Above
When Anyone Faces A Test So Tough
We Ask From Our Master Because In Him We Trust
All Of Our Wishes From His Door We Gain
<<MINI>>
Allah Look At The Heart Of Imam Hussain a.s 3x
<<DIVIDER>>
He Promised This To The Holy Prophet s.a.w.w
He Would Save Islam Whenever Faced Threat
His Grandfather Cried When Hussain a.s Said
This Promise I'll Fulfill If All My Blood Is Shed
I Am Ready To Suffer Any Pain
<<MINI>>
Allah Look At The Heart Of Imam Hussain a.s 3x
<<DIVIDER>>
He's Standing With No One By His Side
Before His Sight His Loved Ones And Family Died
His Heart Is Carrying Such Grief And Fright
And Yet He Stand Away So Much Courage And Pride
He's Standing Covered From Head To Toe In Blood Stain
<<MINI>>
Allah Look At The Heart Of Imam Hussain a.s 3x
<<DIVIDER>>
No One Can Understand The Pain Of Hussain a.s (3x)
He Crawled Towards The Place Where Akber a.s Laying
He Watched His Brother Laying With No Arms
His Six Months Old Ali Asghar a.s Dying In Pain
Never Through Any Of These Did He Complain
<<MINI>>
Allah Look At The Heart Of Imam Hussain a.s 4x
<<DIVIDER>>
Teyjani And Shanawar We Salute
Hussain a.s Our Master And The Clause For Which Is Good
Because Of His Tent In Karbala
Today We Know What Is False And What Is Truth
His Name In All Of Our Hearts To Remain
<<MINI>>
Allah Look At The Heart Of Imam Hussain a.s 3x
Imam Hussain a.s 4x
Allah 3x Look At Th Heart Of Imam Hussain a.s
